# UI/UX Coding Prompt — Landing Page (Theme: 2.AG)

## 1. Project Overview

Build a complete, responsive landing page for a fictional wellness brand inspired by the "Clinical Apothecary" aesthetic described below. **Invent a fictional brand name, product name, and all user-facing copy. Never use, reference, or reproduce any real brand name, logo, trademark, or product name from the source specification.** All copy must be original and in English.

Deliverables: separate `index.html`, `style.css`, and `script.js` files. No inline `<script>` blocks beyond a single deferred entry-point reference. Use one consistent class-naming convention (BEM) across the entire deliverable.

## 2. Strict Architectural Rules

### 2.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS
- Keep all styling strictly inside `style.css`.
- Forbid the use of the `style="..."` attribute in HTML.
- Target all design properties, layout rules, and states via class or ID selectors only.
- Keep HTML clean, semantic, and agnostic of visual styling.

### 2.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens
Store all visual tokens inside `:root` (and theme classes) using CSS variables:

**Colors:**
- `--color-deep-teal: #244d54`
- `--color-mint-pulse: #2ecea0`
- `--color-soft-teal: #6dddbd`
- `--color-carbon: #000000`
- `--color-ink: #151515`
- `--color-graphite: #4d4d4d`
- `--color-slate: #858585`
- `--color-fog: #999999`
- `--color-mist: #e5e7eb`
- `--color-bone: #f0f1f2`
- `--color-paper: #ffffff`

**Generic tokens (required):**
- `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`
- `--radius-sm`, `--radius-md`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`
- `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`
- `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`

Map the generic tokens to the theme colors (e.g., `--primary: var(--color-mint-pulse)`, `--bg-primary: var(--color-paper)`). Enforce contrast pairing for every theme: light backgrounds pair with dark text, dark backgrounds pair with light text.

**Light Mode Background:** Use `#fefefe` where a near-white is needed instead of `#ffffff` for the page canvas token if appropriate; keep `--color-paper: #ffffff` for card surfaces.

**Border Radius & Shadows:** The design deliberately avoids heavy shadows. Use hairline borders (`1px solid var(--color-mist)` or `1px solid var(--color-carbon)`) and tonal surface shifts instead. Define `--shadow-sm` and `--shadow-md` as minimal or none to honor this.

**Spacing & Transitions:** Base unit 4px. Define `--spacing-gap: 16px`, `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`.

### 2.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support
- Provide dark mode color tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and/or a `.dark` class selector.
- Switch background and text CSS variables seamlessly without HTML restructuring.
- Persist user theme choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit.
- Include a visible toggle control with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` state.

### 2.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment
- Build all layout structures using Flexbox (`display: flex`).
- Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless there is an explicitly justified exception.
- All flex layouts must be mobile-responsive (rows convert to columns on smaller viewports). Prevent horizontal scrolling.

### 2.5 Framework Default
Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind's `@layer` / `@apply` directives). All utility classes must map back to CSS variables or generic reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).

### 2.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)
- Include Google Font `<link>` or `@import` tags for **Inter Tight** (weights 400, 500, 600) and **Inter** (weights 400, 500). Bind primary to `--font-inter-tight` and secondary to `--font-inter`.
- Use Google Material Symbols/Icons for all icons. Forbid raw inline SVGs or local icon files.
- Apply OpenType feature `"kern"` on Inter Tight.

## 3. Theme-Specific Design Rules

### 3.1 Color & Surface Usage
- Page canvas: `#ffffff` (Paper). Soft card surface: `#f0f1f2` (Bone). Structural dark: `#244d54` (Deep Teal). Highlight wash: `#2ecea0` (Mint Pulse).
- Section backgrounds must alternate between Paper `#ffffff` and Deep Teal `#244d54` for rhythmic clinical scan.
- Mint `#2ecea0` is used only for filled actions, active dots, dosage badges, and announcement bar — never as body text on white.
- Deep Teal `#244d54` is the background for any section introducing a proof point, statistic, or scientific claim.
- No new chromatic colors. No purples, reds, or warm neutrals.

### 3.2 Typography Scale
Use the following type scale tokens:

| Token | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing |
|-------|------|-------------|----------------|
| `--text-caption` | 10px | 1.86 | 0.09–0.10em (tracked caps) |
| `--text-body` | 16px | 1.5 | 0.005em default |
| `--text-subheading` | 20px | 1.4 | 0.02em |
| `--text-heading-sm` | 30px | 1.3 | 0.02em |
| `--text-heading` | 36px | 1.25 | 0.02em |
| `--text-heading-lg` | 45px | 1.21 | 0.02em |
| `--text-stat-numeral` | 48px | 1.1 | -0.042em |
| `--text-display` | 62px | 1.0 | -0.042em (1.24px) |

- Inter Tight weight 500 for all headlines and CTAs; weight 600 for badges and active filter chips.
- Inter (secondary) for stat block numerals and large product display sizes.
- Letter-spacing: -0.042em at display sizes, 0.005em default, 0.02–0.03em on body, 0.09–0.10em on small uppercase labels.
- Do not mix Inter and Inter Tight within the same line of text.

### 3.3 Spacing & Shapes
- Page max-width: 1280px centered container.
- Section gap: 64px. Card padding: 20px. Element gap: 8–16px.
- Border radius: cards 12–20px, badges 50px (pill), inputs 5px, buttons 30–50px (pill), hero CTA 250px.
- All primary action buttons must be pill radii between 30px and 50px.
- No sharp 0–4px radii on buttons or badges.

### 3.4 Elevation
- No box shadows. Use hairline 1px borders (`#e5e7eb` on white surfaces, `#000000` on neutral fills) and tonal surface steps.

## 4. Component Specifications

### 4.1 Announcement Bar
- Full-width band in `#2ecea0` mint, ~40px height, 12–14px white Inter Tight text, single line, no border, flush above nav. Include a truck icon (Material Symbols) + shipping promise.

### 4.2 Top Navigation
- White bar, ~64px tall. Black wordmark (fictional brand name) left. 3–5 text links (Shop, Science, Contact) in 16px Inter Tight 500 with 15–30px horizontal padding. Search icon and bag icon (with 8px black dot showing item count) right-aligned. No drop shadow, hairline `#e5e7eb` bottom border.

### 4.3 Hero Section
- 50/50 split: left half `#244d54` dark teal editorial panel, right half white product panel.
- Left: headline in Inter Tight 500, 62px, white, letter-spacing ~1.24px, left-aligned at 50–60% width. Pill CTA below: transparent fill, 1px `#2ecea0` mint border, white text 16px, 50px radius, 14px 48px padding.
- Right: circular bubble/bokeh photography behind a product tube. Product image ~60% of panel width, centered. No text overlay.
- Use a placeholder product image (e.g., a styled div or public placeholder) — no real product photography.

### 4.4 Features (3 Cards)
- White card on `#f0f1f2` background, 12–20px radius, 1px `#e5e7eb` border, 20–24px padding.
- Each card: Google Material Icon (thin-line, monochrome), heading in Inter Tight 500, body text in Carbon.
- 3-column grid on desktop, stacking to 1 column on mobile.

### 4.5 How It Works (3 Steps)
- 3-column layout on desktop, stacking on mobile.
- Each step: numbered badge (mint pill), step title (Inter Tight 500), description text.
- Use hairline dividers between steps on desktop.

### 4.6 Testimonials
- Review cards: white `#ffffff` background, 12–20px radius, 1px `#e5e7eb` border, 20–24px padding. Five mint stars at 14px top, 18–20px quote in Inter Tight 500 Ink `#151515`, reviewer name in 12–13px Slate `#858585` with small mint checkmark for verified.
- Include a review marquee row: single horizontal auto-scrolling row, 5-star header left-aligned, then inline reviewer quotes in Inter Tight 14–15px, 500, Carbon — separated by bullets, all caps spaced ~0.05em.
- 4–5 column card grid with one slot swapped for a vertical video card (9:16 poster with centered white circular play button outlined in 1px mint).

### 4.7 Pricing (3 Tiers)
- 3-column card grid. Each card: white `#ffffff` background, 12–20px radius, 1px `#e5e7eb` border, 20–24px padding.
- Tier name, price (large Inter Tight 500), feature list with checkmark icons, CTA button (filled mint pill for recommended tier, outlined for others).
- Highlight recommended tier with a mint border or badge.

### 4.8 FAQ
- Accordion-style. Each item: question in Inter Tight 500, answer in body text. Toggle via click. Use `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
- Hairline `#e5e7eb` dividers between items.

### 4.9 Final CTA
- Deep Teal `#244d54` background section. Headline in white Inter Tight. Filled mint pill CTA button.

### 4.10 Footer
- White background with hairline top border. Multi-column layout: brand wordmark, link groups (Shop, Science, Contact, Legal), social icons (Material Symbols). Small text in Slate.

## 5. Component State Requirements

### 5.1 Button Component
- **Default:** Flex layout (`display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;`). Minimum touch target 44x44px.
- **Hover:** Visual shift (brightness/shadow) with `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus:** Distinct focus ring using CSS variables (`outline` / `box-shadow`) for keyboard navigation.
- **Active/Pressed:** Click transform feedback (`transform: scale(0.97)`).
- **Loading:** Disables interactions, prevents double-clicks, renders CSS spinner or animated Google Icon without distorting dimensions.
- **Disabled:** Reduced opacity (`opacity: 0.5`), greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- **Success/Error:** Temporary feedback state styles driven by `--text-success` or `--text-error`.

### 5.2 Card Component
- **Default:** Flexible Flexbox layout, subtle borders and elevation via `--bg-secondary` and CSS variables.
- **Hover:** Elevation/shadow shift or subtle transform (`transform: translateY(-2px)`).
- **Focus-within:** Highlights card borders when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (Skeleton):** Shimmer animation in CSS to prevent layout jumps.
- **Empty State:** Structured fallback layout with Google Icon and clear guidance text.

### 5.3 Form & Input Requirements
- **States:** Empty, Focused (outline ring), Filled, Valid (success border/icon), Invalid (error border, red text, error icon), Disabled, Read-only.
- **Structure:** Flex container wrapping label, input field, and dedicated error feedback container.
- Input: white fill, 1px `#999999` border, 5px radius, 12–16px padding, 14–16px Inter Tight 400 text in Carbon. Placeholder in `#999999`.

### 5.4 Modal / Popup Requirements
- **States:** Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing (all animated via CSS transitions).
- **UX Features:** Centered flex container (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay, Google Icon close button, keyboard focus trapping, support for closing via `Esc` or overlay clicks.

## 6. Core UX & Micro-Interaction Rules

- **Responsive by Default:** Fluid sizing and responsive breakpoints without horizontal overflow.
- **Smooth Animations:** CSS transitions on all state changes (`transition: var(--transition-normal)`), respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** Sufficient contrast in both Light and Dark modes. Never rely solely on color to communicate state. Semantic HTML5 elements, correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets, logical DOM/focus order, full keyboard operability, and `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback.
- **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** Every user click, hover, or submission must trigger a visible state change.
- **Destructive Actions:** Generic `.btn-danger` or delete actions must be visually distinct in both light and dark themes.

## 7. Stat Block (Special Component)
- Deep Teal `#244d54` background, 20px radius, 40–60px padding.
- Headline numeral 48–62px in a vertical gradient from Soft Teal `#6dddbd` to Mint `#2ecea0`, applied as CSS `background-clip: text` fill.
- Percent sign 24–30px in white, sitting at top-right of the numeral.
- White caption 12px below in 0.09em tracked caps.

## 8. Do's and Don'ts

**Do:**
- Use Inter Tight at weight 500 for all headlines and CTAs; reserve weight 600 for badges and active filter chips.
- Apply Mint `#2ecea0` only for filled actions, active dots, and dosage badges — never as body text on white.
- Use Deep Teal `#244d54` as the background for any section that introduces a proof point, statistic, or scientific claim.
- Set all primary action buttons to pill radii between 30px and 50px.
- Apply letter-spacing of 0.09–0.10em on all uppercase labels and ingredient callouts at 10–12px.
- Use the `#6dddbd`-to-`#2ecea0` vertical gradient via `background-clip: text` only on large stat numerals (48px+); never on body copy.
- Keep section backgrounds alternating between Paper `#ffffff` and Deep Teal `#244d54`.

**Don't:**
- Do not introduce new chromatic colors.
- Do not use sharp 0–4px radii on buttons or badges.
- Do not place Mint text on white at body sizes below 16px.
- Do not use heavy box shadows for elevation.
- Do not mix Inter and Inter Tight within the same line of text.
- Do not use letter-spacing tighter than -0.05em at sizes below 24px.
- Do not add decoration outside the existing palette.

## 9. Imagery & Iconography
- Imagery is sparse and product-led. Use placeholder elements (styled divs or public placeholder images) — no real product photography.
- Icon style is thin-line 1px stroke monochrome, mostly white on teal or black on white. Use Google Material Symbols exclusively.
- Decorative star fields in stat blocks carry no extra imagery — the large gradient numerals do the visual work.

## 10. Dark Mode Mapping
- In dark mode, map light surfaces to dark equivalents (e.g., page canvas to deep teal or near-black, cards to a slightly lighter dark surface), and text to light equivalents. Ensure contrast pairing is maintained. Mint accent remains the primary action color in both modes.

## 11. Deliverable Checklist
- [ ] `index.html` — semantic HTML5, no inline styles, deferred script reference.
- [ ] `style.css` — all tokens in `:root`, dark mode overrides, Flexbox layouts, responsive breakpoints, component states.
- [ ] `script.js` — theme toggle with localStorage persistence, FAQ accordion, mobile nav toggle, marquee animation control, form validation feedback (ask user if validation logic is needed — do not implement unsolicited).
- [ ] All copy is original English, fictional brand/product names, no real trademarks.
- [ ] All icons via Google Material Symbols. All fonts via Google Fonts.
- [ ] No horizontal overflow on any viewport.
